high_level_description: The image features a close-up of an Apple Watch with a digital display showing the time as 10:09 and an image of Earth from space. The watch has a metallic case and a beige strap. In the background, there is a blurred figure wearing a spacesuit, suggesting a space-related theme or context. The text overlay on the image reads: "Apple scraps plan to design display for watch in-house, cutting several dozen jobs." This indicates that Apple has decided against designing the display for its watches internally and will instead outsource the task, leading to job cuts.
